author: Burningtaco_224
body: Sure most people know me as the swearing left and right crazy *** player. But I've personally changed and I believe that I can play again with minimal need for moderators to need to step in. I request that in making this decision do not look at my past infractions for I have changed since then. (p.s I'm like level 26 or something like that and if it hasn't reset I don't want all the time I wasted getting to that level to go to waste.)

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

After thinking long and hard and looking at the logs, I am prepared to give one more chance, don't waste it.
I advise you don't even put a toe nail out of line or you'll find yourself with no chance of getting a second appeal.
Please please don't make me regret this.
-Appealed

Regards,
Auratix, Senior Moderator
